## Read in Data

```{r readdata, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------

# USER: Set this to the root folder of the cloned repository

# -------------------------------------------------------------------

project_dir <- "/path/to/DRC_Electricity_HCFs"

data_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "data")
spatial_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "spatial")
output_dir     <- file.path(data_dir, "temp")

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ===================================================================================
# NOTE TO REPLICATORS
#
# The following files must be downloaded manually into:
#   data/spatial/
#
# rdc_zone_de_sante_09092019.zip      (DRC health zones shapefile)
# cod_ppp_2020.tif                    (WorldPop population raster)
# cod_relative_wealth_index.csv       (Meta RWI dataset)
# acled_drcconflictdata.csv           (ACLED conflict events)
#
# These files are too large to store on GitHub. See the readme file for more details.
# ===================================================================================
```

```{r shapefile, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------ Load & Prepare Health Zones ------------------
zipfile <- file.path(spatial_dir, "rdc_zone_de_sante_09092019.zip")
unzip(zipfile, exdir = file.path(spatial_dir, "hz_unzipped"))

shp_file <- list.files(
  file.path(spatial_dir, "hz_unzipped"),
  pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE
)

health_zones <- st_read(shp_file) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_make_valid()

target_provinces <- c("Nord-Kivu", "Sud-Kivu", "Haut-Katanga")

hz_subset <- health_zones |>
  filter(PROVINCE %in% target_provinces) |>
  select(Nom, PROVINCE)

```

```{r wealth, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}

# ------------------ Load Wealth CSV and Convert to sf ------------------
wealth_file <- file.path(spatial_dir, "cod_relative_wealth_index.csv")
wealth_df <- read_csv(wealth_file)

# Check column names — should include "latitude", "longitude", "rwi"
names(wealth_df)

# Convert to sf
wealth_sf <- st_as_sf(wealth_df, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# ------------------ Spatial Join & Aggregation ------------------
# Spatial join to assign each RWI point to a health zone
wealth_joined <- st_join(wealth_sf, health_zones, join = st_within)

# Aggregate: mean RWI per zone
wealth_by_zone <- wealth_joined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Nom) %>%  
  summarise(wealth_mean = mean(rwi, na.rm = TRUE))

```

```{r popdensity, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------ Load Population Raster ------------------
pop_raster <- rast(file.path(spatial_dir, "cod_ppp_2020.tif"))

# Crop and mask to DRC health zones
hz_vect_sub <- vect(hz_subset)
pop_crop <- crop(pop_raster, hz_vect_sub)
pop_masked <- mask(pop_crop, hz_vect_sub)

# ------------------ Extract Mean Population Density ------------------
# Note: This is people per 100m x 100m cell, so mean is already interpretable
pop_mean_df <- data.frame(pop_density_mean = exact_extract(pop_masked, hz_subset, 'mean'))


# ------------------ Merge with Existing Wealth Data ------------------
zone_names <- hz_subset %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(Nom, PROVINCE)

spatial_covariates <- zone_names %>%
  left_join(wealth_by_zone, by = "Nom") %>%
  bind_cols(pop_density_mean = pop_mean_df$pop_density_mean)
```


```{r roads, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------ Road Access (distance to paved road, road density) ------------------
# Download OSM lines for DRC
roads <- oe_get("Democratic Republic of the Congo",
                layer = "lines",
                extra_tags = c("highway","surface","tracktype"))

# Keep only relevant road types
roads <- roads %>% filter(!is.na(highway))

# Classify paved
paved <- c("asphalt","concrete","paved","chipseal","paving_stones")
major <- c("motorway","trunk","primary","secondary")

roads <- roads %>%
  mutate(is_paved = case_when(
    !is.na(surface) & tolower(surface) %in% paved ~ TRUE,
    tolower(highway) %in% major ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  ))

# Reproject for distances (equal area)
ea_crs <- "EPSG:6933"
hz_ea <- st_transform(hz_subset, ea_crs)
roads_ea <- st_transform(roads, ea_crs)

# Distance to nearest paved road (zone centroid)
hz_pts <- st_point_on_surface(hz_ea)
paved_lines <- roads_ea %>% filter(is_paved)
nn <- st_distance(hz_pts, paved_lines)
dist_km <- apply(nn, 1, min) / 1000
road_dist_df <- data.frame(dist_paved_km = dist_km)

road_dist_df <- data.frame(
  Nom = hz_ea$Nom,              # zone names from your shapefile
  dist_paved_km = dist_km       # distance in km
)

spatial_covariates <- spatial_covariates %>%
  left_join(road_dist_df, by = "Nom")
```


```{r conflict, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------ Load ACLED Conflict Data ------------------
acled_file <- file.path(spatial_dir, "acled_drcconflictdata.csv")
acled <- read_csv(acled_file)

# Convert to sf using lat/long
acled_sf <- st_as_sf(acled, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Spatial join to health zones
acled_joined <- st_join(acled_sf, hz_subset, join = st_within)

# Keep only relevant variables
acled_clean <- acled_joined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    # Parse event_date (ACLED is month/day/year)
    event_date = mdy(event_date),
    year = year(event_date),
    month = month(event_date),  # numeric month (1–12)
    year_month = format(event_date, "%Y-%m"),  # YYYY-MM for merging
    health_zone = Nom,
    province = PROVINCE
  )

# ------------------ Aggregate to health zone x year x month ------------------
acled_agg <- acled_clean %>%
  group_by(province, health_zone, year, month, year_month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_events = n(),
    n_fatalities = sum(fatalities, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_civilian = sum(civilian_targeting, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_event = as.integer(n_events > 0),
    any_fatalities = as.integer(n_fatalities > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conflict_static <- acled_agg %>%
  group_by(province, health_zone) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_events = median(n_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fatalities = median(n_fatalities, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spatial_covariates <- spatial_covariates %>%
  left_join(conflict_static,
            by = c("Nom" = "health_zone", "PROVINCE" = "province")) %>%
  group_by(PROVINCE) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_events = ifelse(is.na(mean_events),
                                  median(mean_events, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  mean_events),
    mean_fatalities = ifelse(is.na(mean_fatalities),
                                      median(mean_fatalities, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      mean_fatalities)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


write_csv(
  spatial_covariates,
  file.path(output_dir, "health_zone_spatial_covariates.csv")
)

write_csv(
  acled_agg,
  file.path(output_dir, "conflict_timevarying.csv")
)
```
